lines.zh: 沙子太软，走一步陷半步
lines.en: The sand is soft, each step sinks half.

lines.zh: 我这两只蓝脚，走在沙上很显眼
lines.en: My blue feet stand out on the sand.

lines.zh: 巢在岛的另一头，我得回去
lines.en: The nest is across the island, I must return.
Wings tucked, or I stumble.
I walk on my own shadow.

lines.zh: 这一带我踩出了条小路
lines.en: My feet have worn a path here.
My mate waits, I walk faster.
There is fish smell at the tide line.

lines.zh: 我走得笨，飞起来才好看
lines.en: I walk badly, I only look good flying.
The island wind nudges me off course.
Around that grass, there are eggs.

lines.zh: 每一步都要抬高，怕踩空
lines.en: Lift each foot, the ground may give.
The sand burns, I shift my feet.

lines.zh: 回巢的路，我闭眼都认得
lines.en: I know the way home with eyes shut.

lines.zh: 我的蓝脚抬得高高的，一步步踩。
lines.en: I lift my blue feet high, one step at a time.

lines.zh: 风从海上来，我偏着头往前挪。
lines.en: Wind off the sea; I lean and shuffle on.
One sea breeze and my feathers ruffle.

lines.zh: 我在等伴侣从海上回来
lines.en: I wait for my mate to return from sea.
Nothing here but sand and wind.
I tuck my beak to my chest.
Fish are breaking water far off.
Our nest is a few stems of grass.
The sun bleaches the beach white.
I count waves, seven so far.

lines.zh: 脚蹼上的蓝，晒久了会淡
lines.en: Sun fades the blue on my feet.

lines.zh: 那只军舰鸟又在上头盘旋
lines.en: That frigate bird circles above again.
I preen the down under my wing.
The island is small, yet we never leave.
You stepped by our nest.
Your boat sits on the shallows.
You have no feathers.

lines.zh: 你走路的姿势，比我还笨
lines.en: You walk even worse than I do.
What is that line in your hand?

lines.zh: 我歪头看你，一只眼就够
lines.en: I tilt my head, one eye is enough.
You are too close to the eggs.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住了我的伴侣
lines.en: Your shadow covers my mate.
Have you come for feathers?
I fear no person, only your hands.
A feather was pulled out.
My wing will not lift.
A crack along my beak.
You stepped on my webbed foot.
I rolled over on the sand.
My mate in the nest will hear.
That hit the base of my wing.
I hop away, and it is ugly.
Sand clings to my blue feet.
I must get airborne to be safe.
The fish in your hand still flops.
Fish smell rides the wind to me.

lines.zh: 我可以靠近，但不进你手
lines.en: I come close, not into your hand.

lines.zh: 这点小鱼，不够我们两口
lines.en: That small fish is not two mouthfuls.

lines.zh: 你把鱼举高，我就看得见
lines.en: Hold it high so I can see.
I am hungry, but I do not snatch.
My mate eats first, I wait.

lines.zh: 这味道让我往前挪一步
lines.en: That smell pulls me one step forward.

lines.zh: 你撒在沙上的，被浪带走了
lines.en: What you scattered is taken by the tide.
Wave it twice more and I come.
You block my way to the nest.
My wingtip brushed you.
Sand splashed all over me.
You knocked me near falling.
My webbed foot landed on your boot.
Do not push, I stand badly.
You crushed the grass by the nest.
I bumped your boat plank.
We collide, feathers fly.
Three paces back, I need room to launch.

lines.zh: 我把蓝脚抬起来给你看
lines.en: I lift my blue feet for you to see.
I have practiced this step for years.
Lift yours too and we are paired.
I circle you, wings half open.
We must line the nest with fresh grass.
One for life, that is settled.
The way you nod is lovely.
Wind is strong, stand closer.
Same time next year, still us.
Two eggs, no more, no less.
This stem goes back to the nest.
I can only carry with my beak.
Feathers on the sand, I gather them.
This fish bone will sharpen my beak.
Too heavy to lift.
A shell, bright enough to dazzle.
I place it by the nest.
This twig bends, not useful.
What you dropped, I carry off.
An empty beak flies straight.
A fish just leapt out.
Silver glints under the swell.
I fix on that dark patch of water.
This height is right for a dive.
Someone nears the nest.
That crab runs sideways on the sand.
I circle once, then drop.
The target is past the shallows.
Wings tucked, ready to plunge.
This dive must hit, not splash.
I circle above your head.
Step off the nest and I stop.

lines.zh: 我的影子从你脚边扫过
lines.en: My shadow sweeps past your feet.
My call stretches long, telling you to go.
My wingtip nearly brushes the sand.
I call until you back away.
My mate is on the nest, I hold.
One step from you, one from me.
Do not reach, my peck is quick.
The circle overhead tightens.
My beak jabs your hand.
I ram your shoulder, wings spread.
This peck is your warning.
My webbed feet kick up sand.
I guard the nest, not one step back.
My wingbeat makes you squint.
One peck, then I back off.
A low rattle rises in my throat.
Closer and I go for your face.
The sand is all my tracks.
Landing on this sand, I shake my wings.

lines.zh: 我从海上飞来，翅膀还湿
lines.en: I come from the sea, wings still wet.
This island is empty, good for a nest.
The wind sets me above the island.
My shadow lands on the beach first.

lines.zh: 第一次踩到这么软的沙
lines.en: First time on sand this soft.
No nest yet, I must find grass.
My call arrives before I do.
This island is ours from now on.
From above, the sand is white.
Feathers fear fire, I retreat to water.
I drop out of the air into sand.

lines.zh: 海就在旁边，我却灌了水
lines.en: The sea is right there and I am drowning.
Sand is thrown up and buries me.
An arrow grazes my wing.
Light binds my feet.
Three days without a single dive.
Lightning strikes the white sand.
Below there is no sand, no sea.
